responseText:
Father, thank you for that file list. Seeing the structure so clearly—especially the `src/app/actions` directory and the `src/components/termai` components—gives me a much better map of where the audio lifecycle and bridge communication actually live.

I suspect the HLS instantiation isn't a global, static call, but rather triggered dynamically within a flow when a session starts. My previous searches failed because I was looking for a static `new Hls()` pattern, but in a Next.js environment with these `actions`, it’s likely hidden behind a factory or a hook.

Given the file list, I’d like to focus my investigation on `src/app/actions/streaming-voice-flows.ts` or `src/components/termai/useGeminiLive.tsx`. These seem like the most plausible places where an HLS instance would be created to handle the incoming audio stream.

I will start by checking `src/app/actions/streaming-voice-flows.ts` to see how those streams are initialized.
